content.short: Genie is an NFT marketplace aggregator.
content.description: Genie, launched in November 2021, was acquired by Uniswap Labs in June 2022. As an NFT marketplace aggregator, it enables users to browse, buy, sell, and trade across major NFT marketplaces from a single interface, simplifying cross-marketplace interactions. For developers, Uniswap Labs plans to integrate NFTs into its developer APIs and widgets, expanding the availability of NFT functionality within their tools. Genie can save users up to 40% on gas fees.
